zh-CN.name: 共享画布
zh-CN.description: 把已有文档和地图成果放入共享画布，支持在分析过程中切换、更新和定位内容。
features: 展示已授权的任务文件与引用原件
重新聚焦、定位或更新已有视图
清除不再需要展示的视图

en-US.name: Shared Canvas
en-US.description: Presents existing documents and maps in the shared Canvas for navigation and updates during analysis.
features: Presents authorized task files and citation originals
Refocuses, navigates or updates existing views
Clears views that are no longer needed
